title: New Places, Same God
verse: So Abram moved his tents and went to live by the oaks of Mamre in Hebron, and he built an altar to the Lord there.
observation: Abraham has had some family drama. He finally decides it is best to separate from his family and go to a new area. The first thing he does is to dedicate this new place to the Lord. This is such a great reminder to us all. Even when circumstances cause our surroundings to change, it does not change the Lord. He is always faithful and always close. No matter what changes, we can always celebrate that He never does.
application: Where do you need to be reminded that the Lord has not changed?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for Your continual faithfulness.
